summary: Found a lifecycle race candidate in SurfaceTextureRenderer: on frame-size changes it queued EGL surface release but immediately resized the Flutter SurfaceProducer and acquired a replacement surface. The new SurfaceReleaseBarrier waits for EGL release completion before changing the backing surface. This ordering is unit-tested and the Android release APK compiles; no Android device was connected, so whether it fixes the black app-only preview is unverified.

checks.name: EGL release/resize ordering
checks.observation: The test verified resize waits for asynchronous EGL release completion and proceeds after synchronous completion. An additional test verified interrupt status is restored after waiting.

checks.name: Android plugin unit tests
checks.observation: The full flutter_webrtc Android unit-test task completed successfully, including the new surface-release barrier tests.

checks.name: Android release compilation
checks.observation: Release APK compiled. The artifact remains locally ignored and was not installed or pushed to Git.

checks.name: Pixel 7 app-only runtime retest
checks.command: ADB device inventory and Flutter device inventory
checks.observation: adb devices returned an empty list; flutter devices reported only macOS and Chrome. No APK install, voice-room join, microphone capture, or screen-share was attempted.

limitations: The EGL-release versus producer-resize race is a source-level candidate, not a proven cause of the black preview.
The connected Pixel test is necessary to verify the production symptom and confirm that full-screen preview remains unaffected.
No receiver was connected, so remote publication and playback were not tested.
remaining: Install 1.0.18+2030 when Pixel 7 is available and repeat Calculator app-only preview, then test full-display capture and a paired receiver. Keep FE-59 open until both local rendering and remote playback pass.
